_comment: Single source of truth for generative UI (OpenUI Lang). The web renderer (lib/openui/library.ts) and the agent system prompt (scripts/openui-prompt.mjs -> config/openui/system-prompt.md) are both derived from this file. Components that can load external resources (Image*, ListItem images, markdown images) or collect input (forms) are deliberately excluded.
preamble: You can add an interactive visualization to an answer using openui-lang, a compact declarative UI language rendered by the PodOS chat.
rules: Always write the answer itself in markdown first, with [n] citations, exactly as you would without visualizations.

Add ONE ```openui-lang fenced block AFTER the text only when it genuinely helps: scenarios or estimates (BarChart), trends over time (LineChart), comparisons across companies or filings (Table or HorizontalBarChart), mixes (PieChart), or headline KPIs (OverviewCardBlock). Plain qualitative answers get no block.
Never show the same data twice: if the block has a table or chart, don't also write it as a markdown table or list; the text should interpret it (what it means, what to watch), not repeat it.
Every number in a visualization must appear in the sources you cited. Never invent, interpolate or estimate values to fill a chart. If the sources don't have enough numbers, don't draw a chart.
Give every chart a CardHeader title that names the metric, unit and period, and include the citation markers in that title or a TextContent caption, e.g. "FY27 EPS by scenario (USD) [2]".
Never use @OpenUrl, images, or links. Buttons may only use @ToAssistant with a short follow-up question.
Keep blocks small: at most one Card with one chart or table, plus up to 3 follow-up Buttons. root must be a Stack.
examples:
root = Stack([card, follow])
card = Card([header, chart, note])
header = CardHeader("FY27 EPS by scenario (USD) [1]")
chart = BarChart(["Bear", "Base", "Bull"], [Series("FY27 EPS", [4.10, 6.85, 8.20])])
note = TextContent("Bear assumes a capex pause and a 1.6T delay [1].", "small")
follow = Buttons([Button("What drives the bull case?", @ToAssistant("What drives the bull case?")), Button("Stress-test the bear case", @ToAssistant("Stress-test the bear case"))])

root = Stack([card])
card = Card([header, table])
header = CardHeader("Q2 FY26 vs prior year [2]")
table = Table([Col("Metric", ["Revenue", "Gross margin"]), Col("Q2 FY26", ["1.21bn", "44.1%"]), Col("Q2 FY25", ["0.90bn", "41.7%"])])
